Individual + province-by-year FE
Hometown OR overlapping school ties | Fixed pre-inspection group
Promotion event study | Full C08 controls | 95% province-clustered t CIs
Identical N = 1,151 officer-years; 227 officials; 17 province clusters.
19 connected officials in 6 provinces. Connected observations at k=-4,...,+4: 7, 10, 16, 19, 13, 10, 6, 6, 0.
Union = hometown OR school tie to either provincial secretary or governor. All four component ties must be known zero to code unconnected.
Unknown ties are excluded. Economics follow the official's appointment city (lagged one year).
Gray periods have no tied observations, not a zero effect. Reference has no estimated CI; points are not connected.
